articles.summary: Evotec SE announced the award of a US$ 2.5 m grant from The Gates Foundation (GF) to support the development of next-generation treatment regimens for tuberculosis (TB). Read the full press release to learn more.
articles.title: Evotec receives $ 2.5 m grant to generate next gen tuberculosis treatments

articles.summary: Evotec welcomes the FDA's “Roadmap to Reducing Animal Testing in Preclinical Safety Studies” which is aligned with our 30+ year commitment to ethics and the principles of 3-Rs (Replacement, Reduction and Refinement). Read the full article to learn more.
articles.title: Evotec response to the FDA’s Roadmap to Reducing Animal Testing
